title: Draft content loss on rapid suggestion dismiss
description: A race condition between suggestion overlay teardown and draft auto-save caused intermittent empty-draft overwrites in earlier cohorts. Mitigation has held with no confirmed recurrence in the last 7 days, including enterprise canary traffic.
workaround: Enable conservative autosave mode for affected cohorts and prompt manual draft save on rapid dismiss.

title: Elevated p95 latency at >10% rollout
description: Inference API p95 latency exceeded target during rapid cohort expansion. Auto-scaling thresholds were tuned and cold-start mitigation added.
workaround: Pre-warm inference pods before expanding rollout cohort.

title: Suggestions use contact names from unrelated threads
description: Context-boundary bug in payload builder could include adjacent thread metadata in suggestions. Patch to scope conversation context has been deployed.
workaround: Dismiss incorrect suggestions if seen; report via in-app feedback.

title: No user-facing toggle to disable Smart Compose
description: v4.12.0 shipped without a user-visible disable toggle. Control is available via support-managed feature flag while UX toggle work is being finalized.
workaround: Users can contact support to disable via feature flag.

title: Suggestion overlay flickers on low-end Android devices
description: On devices with < 4 GB RAM, the ghost-text overlay occasionally flickers during rapid typing. Cosmetic only — no functional impact.
